text:
maria_marketing: Need a reproducible bench package we can cite. Key claims: 95th-pctl latency improvement for our 4-bit quant profile vs fp16 on same instance class, and cache-aware throughput gains.

maria_marketing: We need: exact payload sets (short, long, multi-turn), seeds, model commit sha, profile name, instance type, kernel tag, and run logs. Also want raw sample outputs (50 per workload) for quality spot checks.

tony_runtime: Copy. can you provide qps targets + spike shape?

maria_marketing: short: 150 qps steady, long: 20 qps steady, multi-turn: 60 qps steady with prefix caching. spike test: 400 qps for 30s after 60s warmup at 50% spike qps.

tony_runtime: ok. sara_eng / kevin_data please chime on provenance CSV format and stats.

sara_eng: we'll produce a provenance CSV with columns: input_set_id, payload_file, model_sha, profile, instance, kernel_tag, seed, warmup_policy, start_ts, end_ts. attach run stdout/stderr. recommend warmup: 5 per worker + 60s 50% pre-warm before spike.

kevin_data: Stats plan: compute p50/p90/p95/p99, error rate, tail latency CIs via bootstrap (1000 resamples). run each workload 3x with different seeds and report mean +/- se. include errors.csv and response_samples.jsonl for spot checks.

maria_marketing: investors will ask CIs on p95 specifically. make sure we include 95% CIs.

tony_runtime: infra notes: quant runs must use runtime tag runtime-prod-quant-2026. if any request falls back to fp16 kernel we'll log it and mark run as suspect.

maria_marketing: For slides we need one-liner takeaways for each table and exact phrasing for the claim. we'll review before publishing.

tony_runtime: here's the run template (will attach to the PR):

./run_load_test --model sha:abcd1234 --profile 4bit-q --instance g4dn.xlarge --payload-dir payloads/short --qps 150 --workers 8 --warmup 5 --seed 42 --out run_reports/short_q150_s42.json

maria_marketing: timeline: dry-run demo Friday EOD. can we get preliminary artifacts by Thursday morning?

tony_runtime: short runs today, long + cache variants tomorrow early, spike later. Thursday morning final stats and CIs.

sara_eng: I'll assemble provenance CSV and push to /shared/bench-provenance once kevin_data gives processed tables.

kevin_data: gating checklist: error_rate < 0.5%, no kernel fallbacks, consistent results across seeds. if any gate fails we hold publication.

maria_marketing: understood. also include a tiny qual check: first token distribution and 50 raw responses per workload so we can eyeball hallucination/regression.

tony_runtime: tagging deploy_bot for CI runs.

deploy_bot: [CI] bench-job queued: bench/2129999999 by tony_runtime

deploy_bot: [CI] bench/2129999999 started on runner-9

kevin_data: first run finished. uploading artifact and starting stats pipeline. link: https://redwood-artifacts.internal/bench/2129999999/short_q150_s42.json

maria_marketing: grabbing artifacts now. thanks all.

kevin_data: running bootstrap CIs now. if any p95 CI overlaps between quant and fp16 we should temper the headline.

tony_runtime: note: if cache-enabled long-run shows >10% improvement we can call out cache-aware throughput in a dedicated slide.

sara_eng: provenance CSV uploaded: /shared/bench-provenance/2129999999_provenance.csv

kevin_data: final stats scheduled for Thursday 06:30 PT. will include mean p95 +/- se, bootstrap 95% CI, errors.csv, response_samples.jsonl, and a plain-English takeaway per workload.

maria_marketing: perfect. please add a short methodology blurb we can paste into the appendix: sample selection, warmup, seeds, CI method, gating rules.

tony_runtime: will include methodology + run commands in PR. tagging @maria_marketing when PR is ready for review. :thumbsup:

deploy_bot: [CI] bench/2129999999 completed: artifacts uploaded to /artifacts/bench/2129999999/

maria_marketing: review incoming. if anything looks off I'll post in #marketing immediately.

kevin_data: final note: we'll flag any runs with >0.5% error or kernel fallbacks and include a short appendix note about mitigation steps taken.

maria_marketing: thanks team
